university.name: Springfield Institute of Technology
university.tagline: Academic answers in one student-friendly place

principal.name: Dr. Meera Nair
principal.details: Principal of Springfield Institute of Technology, known for student mentorship, academic planning, and research-focused campus initiatives.

chairman.name: Mr. Arvind Rao
chairman.details: Chairman of the institute governing council, focused on scholarships, infrastructure, and industry partnerships.

subjects.name: Data Structures
subjects.description: Covers arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, hashing, and algorithmic problem solving.

subjects.name: Database Management Systems
subjects.description: Introduces relational design, SQL, normalization, transactions, indexing, and database administration.

subjects.name: Operating Systems
subjects.description: Explores processes, scheduling, memory management, file systems, concurrency, and deadlocks.

subjects.name: Computer Networks
subjects.description: Covers networking models, routing, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, wireless networks, and network security basics.

subjects.name: Engineering Mathematics
subjects.description: Focuses on calculus, matrices, differential equations, probability, and numerical techniques.

subjects.name: Digital Electronics
subjects.description: Includes number systems, logic gates, Boolean algebra, combinational circuits, and sequential circuits.

culturalActivities.name: Aurora Fest
culturalActivities.details: Annual cultural festival with music, dance, theatre, fashion show, art stalls, and inter-college competitions.

culturalActivities.name: Literary Circle
culturalActivities.details: Debates, poetry slams, creative writing sessions, quizzes, and public speaking practice.

culturalActivities.name: Rhythm Club
culturalActivities.details: Student-led music jam sessions, open mic evenings, and band practice.

culturalActivities.name: NSS and Outreach
culturalActivities.details: Community service, cleanliness drives, blood donation camps, and awareness campaigns.
